meta.name: review-animations
meta.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审动效代码,把不够讲究的细节逐条挑出来改到位
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在意界面动效的手感,想有人按高标准帮你挑毛病
copy.tagline_en: Review motion code and flag every detail that falls short of a high craft bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you care about motion feel and want a strict eye on your animation code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会逐条审查你的动画与动效代码,按 Emil Kowalski 的标准默认先挑问题,产出 Before/After 修改表,并给出 Block 或 Approve 的结论。它只审动效代码,不写功能、不修无关 bug。
howto.when: 需要你主动调用这个技能,当你要求审查动画或动效代码时用它。它只动效代码,被要求审一般代码时会拒绝并指向通用审查技能。

say.text: 帮我审查这个下拉菜单的动画代码
这个 toast 的出入场动效有问题吗?
say.note: 按十条标准逐条检查并给结论

say.text: 审下这段动效代码有没有性能问题
say.note: 会标出非 GPU 属性等性能问题

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews your animation and motion code against Emil Kowalski's craft standards, flagging issues by default and returning a Before/After table plus a Block or Approve verdict. It only reviews motion code.
howto.when_en: You must invoke it yourself to review animation or motion code. It reviews motion code only; asked to review general code, it declines and points to a general review skill.

say_en.text: Review the animation code on this dropdown
say_en.note: Returns a Before/After table and a Block/Approve verdict

say_en.text: Is anything wrong with this toast's enter/exit motion?
say_en.note: Checks it against the ten standards and gives a verdict

say_en.text: Check this motion code for performance issues
